incidents.summary: The Belgian Competition Authority sanctioned Haleon alongside two other pharmaceutical companies in a settlement concerning anticompetitive arrangements for placing over-the-counter medicines in pharmacies.

sources.quote: On 24 April 2025, the Belgian Competition Authority (“BCA”) announced, via a press release, that it had imposed fines totalling EUR 11.2 million on pharmaceutical companies Johnson & Johnson, Boehringer Ingelheim and Haleon.

incidents.summary: Haleon agreed to a $4.5 million settlement of allegations that Robitussin's non-drowsy claims were misleading and agreed to remove those claims from covered products' labels and advertising.

sources.title: Robitussin maker settles lawsuit in US over 'non-drowsy' claim
sources.quote: The maker of Robitussin settled a consumer lawsuit that claimed its "non-drowsy" cough and flu medicine causes drowsiness, agreeing to pay $4.5 million and remove the "non-drowsy" claim from its packaging and marketing.

sources.title: Settlement Administrator Angeion Group Announces Proposed Settlement In Calchi v. GlaxoSmithKline Consumer Healthcare Holdings (US) LLC Class Action
sources.quote: Monetary Relief: Haleon has agreed to pay $4.5 million to a Settlement Fund

sources.title: Settlement Administrator Angeion Group Announces Proposed Settlement In Calchi v. GlaxoSmithKline Consumer Healthcare Holdings (US) LLC Class Action
sources.quote: Haleon has also agreed to cease marketing and distributing the Covered Products with labels bearing the "Non-Drowsy" statement

incidents.summary: Most of a proposed class action alleging that Haleon used online trackers despite visitors rejecting them survived its dismissal request.

sources.title: Haleon Is Stuck With Proposed False Cookie Banner Class Lawsuit
sources.quote: Haleon US Inc. failed to convince a federal court to dismiss most of a lawsuit over its alleged use of online trackers even when website visitors tried to disable them.

sources.title: Haleon Is Stuck With Proposed False Cookie Banner Class Lawsuit
sources.quote: Plaintiff Jonathan Gabrielli said he indicated through a pop-up cookie banner that he’d reject online trackers, but the website failed to disable the third-party software.

incidents.summary: An investigation linked Haleon's packaging supplier Asia Symbol to plantations that cleared nearly 30,000 hectares of forest, and Haleon said it was cutting ties with the supplier.

sources.title: Indonesia orangutan forest cleared for 'carbon-neutral' packaging firm | AFP.com
sources.quote: But the investigation found that its Asia Symbol affiliate received pulp from a mill fed by plantations that cleared nearly 30,000 hectares of forest between 2016 and 2024 -- an area almost three times the size of Paris.

sources.title: Indonesia orangutan forest cleared for 'carbon-neutral' packaging firm | AFP.com
sources.quote: Asia Symbol makes "carbon-neutral" packaging there that Haleon used for ibuprofen

sources.title: Indonesia orangutan forest cleared for 'carbon-neutral' packaging firm | AFP.com
sources.quote: Haleon said it was cutting ties with Asia Symbol after the investigation, which used satellite data, audit documents, trade records and ship-tracking to trace wood grown on cleared rainforest in Borneo to Asia Symbol's supply chain.
